name: Oc
summary: Ốc is the snail plate. Vietnam Tourism names snail dishes and does not name a species. Vietnam Airlines names ốc hương, ốc mỡ, ốc len, and ốc móng tay, cooked with tamarind, scallion oil, salt, or butter and garlic, and prints 50,000–150,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism points at the beaches’ restaurants and the Back Beach night market. Vietnam Airlines names Lý Tự Trọng, Kha Vạn Cân, and Trương Công Định.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the snails fresh and crisp-sweet, with rau răm and a sour-spicy dip. Vietnam Tourism prints no recipe.
howToEat: Order a shared plate. Rau răm and the dip are on the Vietnam Airlines account.
The methods it names are xào me, nướng mỡ hành, rang muối, and xào bơ tỏi.
Vietnam Airlines prints 50,000–150,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no price. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Lý Tự Trọng, Kha Vạn Cân, and Trương Công Định. Vietnam Tourism also names the beaches’ restaurants and the Back Beach night market, without a street. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 50,000–150,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no price.
